summary: Narwhals implementation of the expression system, compiling the unified AST to nw.Expr so pandas, PyArrow, Dask, DuckDB, Polars and lazy Narwhals frames can be targeted through one layer. It composes the same protocol mixins as the other backends. NarwhalsBaseExpressionSystem is the largest base (about 600 lines): it resolves operand types across pandas/Polars-lazy/other natives and provides identify_native_issue, which classifies native exceptions for the capability layer. Imported only if narwhals is installed.
key_classes: NarwhalsExpressionSystem — composed concrete backend registered for CONST_BACKEND.NARWHALS
NarwhalsBaseExpressionSystem — BACKEND_NAME='narwhals', nw.Expr check, operand-type resolution, identify_native_issue
SubstraitNw*/MountainAshNw* mixins — per-family implementations under substrait/ and extensions_mountainash/
key_functions: _identify_native_issue(error, *, operation_key=None, arguments=None) — classify native engine errors into capability issue classes
NarwhalsBaseExpressionSystem.field_operand_type(input_data, field) — handles pandas and Polars-lazy natives
extension_points: @register_expression_system(CONST_BACKEND.NARWHALS) registers the composed class with the visitor factory
declare_builtin_expression_system(<cls>, 'narwhals') declares the system for function-mapping lowering

Add an operation by implementing the protocol method in the matching substrait/ or extensions_mountainash/ expsys_*_<family> mixin, which is composed by multiple inheritance (backend-composition principle)
Override BaseExpressionSystem hooks (is_native_expression, field_operand_type, infer_expression_operand_type, fixed_result_type)
